title: The Amazing World of Gumball
description: British-American animated sitcom created by Ben Bocquelet for Cartoon Network. It premiered on 2011-05-03 and ran for six seasons and 240 episodes until 2019-06-24. The series follows 12-year-old Gumball Watterson, a blue cat, and his adopted goldfish brother Darwin in the fictional city of Elmore, along with their sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard. It is known for mixing 2D animation, CGI, stop-motion and live-action backgrounds in the same scenes, and for its surreal and satirical humour. It was the first full-length series produced by Cartoon Network Development Studio Europe (later Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe). A revival, The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball, began in 2025.
